belongs_to_collection.name: Winter at the Grand Meridian Collection

data.overview: A writer takes a caretaker post at a vast mountain hotel that closes for the winter, bringing his wife and young son to live in its empty halls. As the snow seals them away, the building's buried history begins to press on the family and the caretaker's fragile mind.
data.tagline: The longest winter is the one inside.
data.title: Winter at the Grand Meridian
